arrive.speaker: narrator
arrive.text: The floor ripples like water. Something vast uncoils from beneath it - a sea serpent crowned in horn, eyes like drowned lanterns.

b1.speaker: kagami
b1.text: ...So he finally sent someone. And so young.

b2.speaker: kagami
b2.text: I have held this tide for three hundred years, child. Behind it waits something that wears a holy face and eats the light of worlds.

choices.text: Then why does my master want you dead?

b_why.speaker: kagami
b_why.text: You already know. You just haven't let yourself hear it.

b_fight.speaker: kagami
b_fight.text: If I must fall, I will not fall lying down. Come.
